PURITY: no env, no DB, no network; reads only structured diagnostics; never reads winning_outcome / real_pnl_usd / any outcome field; no title/slug/text inference

SPORT_GATE.SURFACE: diagnostics.providerSportFamily (must be a non-empty string; diagnostics must be a non-array object)

MARKET_TYPE_RESOLUTION.CONTRADICTION_DEFINITION: normalizeMarketText(nested) !== normalizeMarketText(flat) (case/whitespace/punctuation/diacritic-insensitive equality passes; anything else fails closed)

CANONICAL_MARKET_CLASS.LITERAL_BINARY_NOTE: A structured market type of the literal string 'BINARY' classifies as unknown and is rejected. The producer's own top-level BINARY check is unchanged and independent.

COMPOSITION.ACCEPTED_CLASS_COUNT_SOURCE: canonical class of the exact T-90 snapshot row the producer selected (observationId + created_at)
